Name: Liang Shuang
Text: MovieTalk Table - Liang Shuang

Name: Placeholder
Text: Placeholder

Name: Karenina
Text: I'm in. The whole place is sealed under combat lockdown... Commandant, where do I go from here?

Name: Commandant
Text: Based on the coordinates Lee decrypted, the central control is ahead on your right. In combat lockdown, only one normal entrance stays open.

Name: Karenina
Text: This way, right?

Name: Commandant
Text: The protocol says the Fenrir node has the highest security level. If we want to override the old protocol cleanly, we need to avoid triggering a security self-check.

Name: Karenina
Text: Yeah, yeah. I'll be careful—

Name: Karenina
Text: Huh? Warning lights... the path is blocked. But I didn't go the wrong way, did I?

Name: Karenina
Text: So much for the only entrance... Guess I'll have to force my way through—

Name: Commandant
Text: Karenina, aren't we supposed to avoid damage so the system doesn't start a self-check?

Name: Commandant
Text: First, no Blast Hammer. Second, no explosives. And third, no "let's just take it apart and see!"

Name: Karenina
Text: That doesn't sound like you. Who wrote that?

Name: Commandant
Text: Teddy put it in the notes.

Name: Karenina
Text: Notes are not for dumping random nonsense. Fine, fine, I get it... Commandant, mark the power distribution terminal first.

Name: Karenina
Text: The Fenrir node's power distribution should work like the other areas. If I check the power flow and the lines, I can trace another way into central control.

Name: Karenina
Text: Basically, we're taking a softer approach and finding another way around. I just don't usually bother showing off... but I am smart, you know.

Name: Karenina
Text: This is it. But I need a bit of access first before I can read the power layout.

Name: Commandant
Text: A bit of access?

Name: Karenina
Text: Don't worry. If we're overriding the old protocol, getting access was always the first problem to solve. So...

Name: Karenina
Text: If I enter this here... it should wake the "agent" Teddy built into the protocol.

Name: Commandant
Text: Teddy?

Name: Karenina
Text: It's just an AI avatar. Come on, let's move. We're taking that access.

Name: Teddy AI
Text: This should be entered at central control, not here. This is only a power distribution terminal. In theory, this will take about seven times longer—

Name: Karenina
Text: Doesn't matter! Brave little bear fears no challenge. Go!

Name: Commandant
Text: An alarm? Karenina, watch out!

Name: Karenina
Text: Enemy attack. The Corrupted are closing in. I'll hold them off... Teddy, hurry up.

Name: Teddy AI
Text: First, I am not Teddy. Second—"Doesn't matter! Brave Karenina fears no challenge. Go!"

Name: Karenina
Text: Done. What about you?

Name: Teddy AI
Text: Done. A little earlier than you, actually.

Name: Karenina
Text: What is this? Why is there another lock?

Name: Teddy AI
Text: I'm only a preset protocol override routine. Extra decryption services were not included.

Name: Teddy AI
Text: Open it yourself. It's easy. About as weak as your terminal firewall.

Name: Karenina
Text: Don't think I can't do anything to you just because you're an AI!

Name: Teddy AI
Text: Tsk. Don't tell me you're scared.

Name: Karenina
Text: Bring it on!

Name: Karenina
Text: Hmph. A little trick like this—

Name: Teddy AI
Text: Friendly reminder: The Corrupted are surrounding multiple functional units. You might want to run.

Name: Karenina
Text: You're only telling me now? Thanks. A. Lot.

Name: Karenina
Text: Based on this power distribution, central control should be one floor directly below the surveillance hall.

Name: Karenina
Text: Follow the power lines, and we'll reach the surveillance hall. This way... straight ahead!

Name: Karenina
Text: Phew... still not there. This route was definitely not made for people.

Name: Commandant
Text: Are you tired? Just a little farther...

Name: Karenina
Text: I never said I was tired.

Name: Karenina
Text: I mean this is a power route... not a walking path.

Name: Karenina
Text: We're here!

Name: Karenina
Text: It's really just one floor down... that's it.

Name: Commandant
Text: Is something wrong?

Name: Karenina
Text: The Corrupted caught up. They really don't give up.

Name: Karenina
Text: Just small fry. I hope central control isn't full of them too... Last thing I need is dropping in, stepping on someone's face, and wrecking the place on the way down.

Name: Karenina
Text: That AI looks like Teddy and has the same nasty temper too. Better not give her a reason to nag me.

Name: Karenina
Text: Commandant, I'll use the surveillance center drones to sweep the area first.

Name: Karenina
Text: There, there, and there. Nice hiding spots. Too bad I saw them coming.

Name: Karenina
Text: Commandant, I found it.

Name: Karenina
Text: Central control terminal. Entering...

Name: Teddy AI
Text: Beginning protocol override—

Name: Karenina
Text: Can this progress bar move any faster?

Name: Teddy AI
Text: Please don't ask an AI to do the impossible.

Name: Karenina
Text: Too slow. Too slow! Those small fry are going to notice any second.

Name: Teddy AI
Text: Hello. You have reached Teddy's preset proxy service. Your old protocol is being overridden. Please wait patiently. Press 1 to be quiet, press 2 to disappear, or press 3 to return to option 1.

Name: Karenina
Text: You piece of...!

Name: Teddy AI
Text: Speed-up service is for members only. Would you like to upgrade? All it takes is ten years of errands for the Engineering Force vice-captain.

Name: Karenina
Text: Don't think I can't deal with an AI!

Name: Karenina
Text: I'll settle this with you later!
